title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 3, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $10,000.00
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 3, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $10,000.00
  to support Wilshire Community Police Station’s Cadet Program, as set forth. [BPC #26-264]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.
summary: Approval of $10,000 donation to Wilshire Community Police Station's Cadet Program.
